description: This file defines a GUI dialog class 'ExclusionMatrix' for managing a behavior exclusion matrix within the BORIS software. The dialog allows users to check or uncheck behavior pairs to indicate whether behaviors are mutually exclusive, providing buttons for bulk actions like select all, unselect all, revert, and confirm/cancel the selections.

classes.name: ExclusionMatrix
classes.description: A PySide6 dialog window for managing a matrix of mutually exclusive behaviors, providing a user interface with a table and control buttons.

methods.name: __init__(self)
methods.description: Constructor initializing the exclusion matrix dialog UI components, layouts, buttons, and their event connections.

methods.name: pb_selected(self, to_check: bool)
methods.description: Checks or unchecks all checkboxes within selected ranges in the exclusion matrix table based on the to_check parameter.

methods.name: pb_cb_selection(self, mode)
methods.description: Sets checkboxes in the entire matrix to checked, unchecked, or reverts their state based on the mode argument.

methods.name: cb_clicked(self)
methods.description: Synchronizes the state of pairs of checkboxes representing mutual exclusion relationships between behaviors.
